title: Moving & Storage in Glendale | SOS Moving
metaDescription: Moving and storage in Glendale, CA for lease gaps, remodels and interstate moves: one crew packs rooms, holds the load in climate control and brings it back.
heroSubtitle: Rooms have to be empty on a date somebody else picked. We pack them, hold the load in climate-controlled storage and bring it back when you are ready.

faq.question: Can you pick up in Glendale if I only know the pickup date?
faq.answer: Yes. We book the pickup, the load goes into climate-controlled storage, and the return date is set later by a call. Terms extend with no penalty, so an open-ended wait is ordinary here rather than a problem.

faq.question: My building downtown wants a certificate of insurance. Can you provide one?
faq.answer: We issue a COI for $50 and send it to the management office ahead of the date. Tell us the building’s requirements when you book, so the paperwork is filed before the elevator window is held.

faq.question: How long can a load stay in storage?
faq.answer: From a few days to as long as you need. Short-term covers days and weeks, long-term starts at a month, and either one rolls forward whenever you call. Nothing has to be decided on day one.

faq.question: Can the crew pick up and deliver on the same day?
faq.answer: Sometimes. On blocks where the city’s ADA curb ramp crews hold the street until 4pm, we usually split the two visits instead: the load stays overnight for a flat $200 and the return runs the next morning.

faq.question: What does a Glendale storage job actually cost?
faq.answer: Crew time is billed by the hour for the team you book — two movers with a truck are $119 an hour in cash Monday through Thursday — plus $30 fuel and a $50 deposit that comes off the bill. Call 909-443-0004 with a room count for a figure on your own inventory.

faq.question: We are leaving Glendale for another state. Will you hold everything until the new place is ready?
faq.answer: That is in-transit storage. Your things stay with us after the pickup and go out with the long-distance crew on your destination date, so nothing needs a second arrangement at the other end.
